markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (68%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier 1 frozen section cannot exclude InSitu [F1] and flags inferior (215 um) and medial (323 um) margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 68%, InSitu 31%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% | Leans Invasive; substantial InSitu risk |
| Conformal set | {Invasive, InSitu} (alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Invasive from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, OOD 1.0, 12/12 regions [F6] | High reliability; atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive (60%), 2/5 InSitu (40%) [F5] | Split neighbors; closest is InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · +0.85 score [F2]; unreliable (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · +0.39 score [F3]; unreliable (3/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 6, 10) · ↓ invasive · -0.35 score toward InSitu [F4] (12/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · +0.07 score (19/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops risk above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions are InSitu, like 83%-similar InSitu case BACH_0070 (differs in unreliable mitoses and necrosis).
- Severity-3 simulated frozen-section stain degradation causes false-positive inferior and medial margin calls.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 8, 1, 9**: Highest risk (97%–100%); confirm stromal invasion versus InSitu.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 10, 3**: Compare duct-confined atypia with stromal invasion; frozen-section stains blocked.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8, 9**: Check tumor at medial (323 um) and inferior (215 um) margins.
